articles.title: Under pressure, Ledger unveils plan to turn its crypto hardware wallet into a smartphone
articles.snippet: Ledger’s Atom will run apps like WhatsApp and Instragram and let users switch between smartphone functions and a protected mode for managing digital assets.

articles.title: Ledger’s answer to wallet tampering costs $849 and ships next year
articles.snippet: Ledger’s new Atom combines crypto wallet security with everyday apps and is expected to ship in summer 2027 as the company investigates tampered wallets sold in Asia.

articles.title: Ledger Announces Atom Touchscreen Android Device
articles.snippet: Ledger says the Android-based Atom will carry anti-tamper protections and be sold only on its site, as it probes tampered resold wallets.
